displayName: Merged Pad Chart Time Series by Window (Zoom)
description: Merged telemetry for pad-level labeller charts. Uses the requested zoom resolution mode when provided, falls back to pad-only 120-second rollups, selected-well 60-second rollups, and selected-stage raw telemetry. Zoom-specific copy with explicit resolution_mode support for refetch-on-zoom dashboards.
sql: SELECT * FROM ( WITH bounds AS (   SELECT     (:start_time)::timestamp - (:context_minutes || ' minutes')::interval AS context_start_ts,     (:end_time)::timestamp + (:context_minutes || ' minutes')::interval AS context_end_ts ), scope_base AS (   SELECT     CASE WHEN CAST(:well_name AS TEXT) IN ('', '__ALL__') THEN NULL ELSE CAST(:well_name AS TEXT) END AS selected_well,     CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NULL OR CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) < 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS selected_stage,     CASE       WHEN CAST(:resolution_mode AS TEXT) IN ('raw', 'rollup_60s', 'rollup_120s') THEN CAST(:resolution_mode AS TEXT)       ELSE NULL     END AS requested_resolution_mode ), scope AS (   SELECT     selected_well,     selected_stage,     CASE       WHEN selected_stage IS NOT NULL THEN 'raw'       WHEN requested_resolution_mode IS NOT NULL THEN requested_resolution_mode       WHEN selected_well IS NULL THEN 'rollup_120s'       ELSE 'rollup_60s'     END AS resolution_mode,     CASE       WHEN requested_resolution_mode = 'rollup_60s' THEN 60       WHEN requested_resolution_mode = 'rollup_120s' THEN 120       WHEN selected_well IS NULL THEN 120       ELSE 60     END AS rollup_bucket_seconds   FROM scope_base ), pad_wells AS (   SELECT DISTINCT name   FROM merged_well_index_v1_wid2   CROSS JOIN scope sc   WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(fleet_name, ''), 'Unknown') = :fleet_name     AND COALESCE(NULLIF(pad_name, ''), 'Unknown') = :pad_name     AND (sc.selected_well IS NULL OR name = sc.selected_well) ), rollup_telemetry AS (   SELECT     CAST(r.name AS TEXT) || ':' || CAST(r.bucket_ts AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id,     r.name AS well_name,     r.bucket_ts AS timestamp,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num,     r.rate_slurry_avg AS rate_slurry,     r.press_mainline_avg AS press_mainline,     CASE       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'inline' THEN r.prop_conc_inline_avg       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'target' THEN r.prop_conc_target_avg       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'auger' THEN r.prop_conc_blend_auger_avg       ELSE r.prop_conc_blend_denso_avg     END AS selected_concentration,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS context_anchor,     r.records_in_bucket AS records_in_bucket   FROM merged_fleet_stream_customer_rollup_v1_wid2 r   JOIN pad_wells w ON w.name = r.name   CROSS JOIN bounds b   CROSS JOIN scope sc   WHERE sc.selected_stage IS NULL     AND sc.resolution_mode <> 'raw'     AND r.bucket_seconds = sc.rollup_bucket_seconds     AND r.fleet_name = :fleet_name     AND r.pad_name = :pad_name     AND r.bucket_ts BETWEEN b.context_start_ts AND b.context_end_ts ), raw_window_telemetry AS (   SELECT     CAST(t.name AS TEXT) || ':' || CAST(t.record_ts AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id,     t.name AS well_name,     t.record_ts AS timestamp,     s.stage_num AS stage_num,     t.rate_slurry,     t.press_mainline,     CASE       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'inline' THEN t.prop_conc_inline       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'target' THEN t.prop_conc_target       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'auger' THEN t.prop_conc_blend_auger       ELSE t.prop_conc_blend_denso     END AS selected_concentration,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS context_anchor,     1 AS records_in_bucket   FROM merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2_wid2 t   JOIN pad_wells w ON w.name = t.name   CROSS JOIN bounds b   CROSS JOIN scope sc   LEFT JOIN nextier_copper_stage_index_v1_wid2 s     ON s.well_name = t.name    AND t.record_ts >= COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_start_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS timestamp))    AND t.record_ts <= COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp))   WHERE sc.selected_stage IS NULL     AND sc.resolution_mode = 'raw'     AND t.record_ts BETWEEN b.context_start_ts AND b.context_end_ts ), stage_windows AS (   SELECT     s.well_name AS name,     s.stage_num AS stage_num_td,     COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_start_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS timestamp)) AS stage_start_ts,     COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) AS stage_end_ts   FROM nextier_copper_stage_index_v1_wid2 s   JOIN pad_wells w ON w.name = s.well_name   CROSS JOIN scope sc   WHERE sc.selected_stage IS NOT NULL     AND s.stage_num = sc.selected_stage ), base_stage AS (   SELECT     t.name AS well_name,     t.record_ts,     sw.stage_num_td AS stage_num,     t.rate_slurry,     t.press_mainline,     CASE       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'inline' THEN t.prop_conc_inline       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'target' THEN t.prop_conc_target       WHEN :concentration_feature = 'auger' THEN t.prop_conc_blend_auger       ELSE t.prop_conc_blend_denso     END AS selected_concentration   FROM merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2_wid2 t   JOIN stage_windows sw     ON sw.name = t.name    AND t.record_ts >= sw.stage_start_ts    AND t.record_ts <= sw.stage_end_ts   CROSS JOIN bounds b   WHERE t.record_ts BETWEEN b.context_start_ts AND b.context_end_ts ), raw_stage_telemetry AS (   SELECT     CAST(well_name AS TEXT) || ':' || CAST(record_ts AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id,     well_name,     record_ts AS timestamp,     stage_num,     rate_slurry,     press_mainline,     selected_concentration,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS context_anchor,     1 AS records_in_bucket   FROM base_stage ), td_breaks AS (   SELECT DISTINCT     s.well_name AS well_name,     COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) + INTERVAL '1 millisecond' AS break_ts   FROM nextier_copper_stage_index_v1_wid2 s   JOIN pad_wells w ON w.name = s.well_name   CROSS JOIN bounds b   CROSS JOIN scope sc   WHERE COALESCE(s.continuous_end_ts, s.stage_end_ts) IS NOT NULL     AND COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) >= b.context_start_ts     AND COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) < b.context_end_ts     AND (sc.selected_stage IS NULL OR s.stage_num = sc.selected_stage) ), boundary_points AS (   SELECT     CAST(w.name AS TEXT) || ':context_start:' || CAST(context_start_ts AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id,     CAST(w.name AS TEXT) AS well_name,     context_start_ts AS timestamp,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS rate_slurry,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS press_mainline,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS selected_concentration,     0.0 AS context_anchor,     0 AS records_in_bucket   FROM pad_wells w CROSS JOIN bounds   UNION ALL   SELECT     CAST(w.name AS TEXT) || ':context_end:' || CAST(context_end_ts AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id,     CAST(w.name AS TEXT) AS well_name,     context_end_ts AS timestamp,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS rate_slurry,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS press_mainline,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS selected_concentration,     0.0 AS context_anchor,     0 AS records_in_bucket   FROM pad_wells w CROSS JOIN bounds ), line_breaks AS (   SELECT     CAST(well_name AS TEXT) || ':stage_break:' || CAST(break_ts AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id,     CAST(well_name AS TEXT) AS well_name,     break_ts AS timestamp,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS rate_slurry,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS press_mainline,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS selected_concentration,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS context_anchor,     0 AS records_in_bucket   FROM td_breaks ) SELECT * FROM raw_stage_telemetry UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_window_telemetry UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rollup_telemetry UNION ALL SELECT * FROM boundary_points UNION ALL SELECT * FROM line_breaks ORDER BY well_name, timestamp, telemetry_point_id ) q
